notes:
{点|てん} is a versatile counter used for points/scores and items. It also functions as a noun meaning "point" or "aspect."

COUNTER USES:
- Scores/points: 100{点|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to get 100 points)
- Items: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧3{点|てん} (3 items)
- Works of art: ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧10{点|てん} (10 works)

AS A NOUN:
- {点|てん}: a point, dot, spot
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{点|てん}: that point/aspect
- ⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧: problem point, issue

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧{点|てん}?: How many points?
- ⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: perfect score
- ⟦{点数|てんすう}→点数：04543_tensuu⟧: score, number of points
- ⟦{得点|とくてん}→得点：04909_tokuten⟧: score earned (in a game or test)
- 〜⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{点|てん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in terms of ~
